name: Clear quartz
summary: The all-purpose stone: amplifying, clarifying and holding intention.
body:
Clear quartz is the most common crystal in magical practice and the easiest to find. It is said to amplify whatever intention you give it, so it is often added to a working to strengthen it.

It can stand in for almost any other stone. It is linked with the Sun, with spirit and with clarity of mind.

Many people cleanse it in moonlight or with smoke and then "program" it by holding it and stating a clear intention.

name: Amethyst
summary: Calm, intuition, dreams, spiritual work and clear thinking.
body:
Amethyst is purple quartz. Its old Greek name meant "not drunk", from a belief that it kept the wearer clear-headed.

In practice it is used for calm, intuition, meditation, dreams and spiritual protection. Many keep a piece by the bed or on the altar during divination.

It is linked with Jupiter, with the color purple and with air or water. Long sun exposure can fade its color, so keep it out of strong light.

name: Rose quartz
summary: Love, self-love, friendship, comfort and gentleness.
body:
Rose quartz is soft pink quartz and the classic stone of love in every form: romantic, friendly, family and self-love.

It is used to invite affection, ease a hurt heart, make peace after an argument and bring gentleness into a home.

It belongs to Venus, to Friday and to the color pink. Like amethyst, it can fade in strong sunlight.

name: Citrine
summary: Prosperity, success, confidence, warmth and good cheer.
body:
Citrine is golden or honey-colored quartz, sometimes called the merchant's stone because it is kept in cash drawers for good business.

It is used for money, success, confidence, creativity and a sunny mood. It is linked with the Sun, with Sunday and with fire.

Much citrine for sale is heated amethyst. Both work for most practitioners; it is simply worth knowing what you are buying.

name: Black tourmaline
summary: Protection, grounding and turning away negativity.
body:
Black tourmaline is one of the most popular protection stones. It is used to ground, to shield, and to turn away hostile or heavy energy.

Many people place it by the front door, at the corners of a room or near the bed. It is linked with Saturn, with earth and with the color black.

It pairs well with salt in protective workings.

name: Obsidian
summary: Volcanic glass: protection, truth, scrying and shadow work.
body:
Obsidian is natural volcanic glass, black and shining. In ancient Mexico it was worked into blades and mirrors, and black obsidian mirrors were used for seeing and divination.

Today it is used for protection, cutting cords, facing hard truths and scrying. It is linked with Saturn, with fire and earth, and with the color black.

Its edges can be sharp: handle raw pieces with care.

name: Smoky quartz
summary: Grounding, releasing stress and steady protection.
body:
Smoky quartz is brown to gray quartz, darkened by natural radiation in the earth. It is a gentle grounding stone.

It is used to release worry, steady the mind, protect the home, and help turn plans into practical action. It is linked with Saturn, with earth and with brown and black.

It is a good companion for waning moon work.

name: Carnelian
summary: Courage, motivation, creativity and vitality.
body:
Carnelian is an orange to red stone with a warm glow. It has been carved into seals and beads for thousands of years.

It is used for courage, motivation, creative energy, speaking up and finding the drive to begin. It is linked with Mars and the Sun, with fire and with orange and red.

Carry it when you need nerve.

name: Tiger's eye
summary: Confidence, focus, good judgment, luck and protection.
body:
Tiger's eye is a golden-brown stone with a shifting band of light, like a cat's eye. It was once carried against the evil eye.

It is used for confidence, focus, clear judgment, luck in money and steady protection. It is linked with the Sun, with earth and fire, and with gold and brown.

It suits job interviews, negotiations and new ventures.

name: Moonstone
summary: The Moon, intuition, cycles, new beginnings and the Goddess.
body:
Moonstone is a pale feldspar with a soft blue or white shimmer that seems to move like moonlight.

It is used for intuition, dreams, emotional balance, new beginnings and honoring the Goddess. It is linked with the Moon, with Monday, with water and with silver.

Many practitioners charge it under the full moon.

name: Labradorite
summary: Magic, intuition, transformation and protection of the aura.
body:
Labradorite is a gray stone that flashes blue, green and gold when it catches the light. That flash is why many call it the stone of magic.

It is used for intuition, psychic work, transformation and shielding your energy. It is linked with the Moon and with water.

It is a favorite for the altar and for divination.

name: Selenite
summary: Cleansing, peace, clarity and charging other stones.
body:
Selenite is a soft, white form of gypsum with a silky shine. Its name comes from the Greek word for the Moon.

It is used for cleansing spaces and other crystals, calm, clarity and connecting with spirit. Many lay other stones on a selenite plate to clear and charge them.

It is soft and dissolves in water, so never wash it or leave it damp.

name: Jade
summary: Prosperity, luck, harmony, long life and something precious.
body:
Jade covers two green stones, jadeite and nephrite. Across many cultures it has meant value, harmony and good fortune. In ancient Mesoamerica green jade was more precious than gold.

It is used for prosperity, luck, peace in the home and lasting friendship. It is linked with Venus, with earth and with green.

Many imitations are sold as jade, so buy from a trusted seller.

name: Malachite
summary: Transformation, protection, growth and breaking old patterns.
body:
Malachite is a bright green copper stone with dark bands and swirls.

It is used for transformation, protection, courage to change and breaking old patterns. It is linked with Venus and with earth.

Its dust is toxic: never sand or cut it, never use it in water you will drink or bathe in, and wash your hands after handling raw pieces. Polished stones are safe to keep and carry.

name: Lapis lazuli
summary: Wisdom, truth, honest speech and inner vision.
body:
Lapis lazuli is a deep blue stone flecked with gold pyrite. In the ancient world it was treasured by royalty and ground into the blue paint of sacred images.

It is used for wisdom, truthful speech, study, inner vision and dignity. It is linked with Jupiter, with Thursday and with deep blue.

It suits writing, teaching and any work that needs courage to speak.

name: Turquoise
summary: Protection, travel, friendship, good luck and the sky.
body:
Turquoise is a sky-blue to green stone prized across the Americas. In Mesoamerica it was used in mosaics and offerings, and it is still widely worn in Mexico and the American Southwest.

It is used for protection, especially on journeys, for friendship, luck and clear communication. It is linked with Venus and Jupiter and with air and water.

It is porous, so keep it away from oils, perfume and long soaks.

name: Pyrite
summary: Fool's gold: money, confidence, protection and willpower.
body:
Pyrite is a brassy gold mineral, often found in perfect cubes. Its nickname, fool's gold, makes it a playful money stone.

It is used for prosperity, confidence, willpower and a shield against negativity. It is linked with Mars and the Sun and with fire and earth.

Keep it dry, since damp makes it tarnish and crumble, and do not put it in drinking water.

name: Hematite
summary: Grounding, focus, strength and returning negativity.
body:
Hematite is a heavy, metallic gray iron stone with a mirror shine.

It is used for grounding, focus, strength and protection; its mirror surface is said to send negativity back where it came from. It is linked with Mars and Saturn and with earth.

It is a good stone to hold when you feel scattered.

name: Green aventurine
summary: Luck, opportunity, prosperity and optimism.
body:
Green aventurine is a quartz with tiny flecks that sparkle in the light. It is often called the luckiest of stones.

It is used for good luck, new opportunities, money, games of chance and a hopeful outlook. It is linked with Venus and Jupiter and with green and earth.

It makes a good pocket stone for job hunting.

name: Fluorite
summary: Focus, order, study and a clear mind.
body:
Fluorite forms in cubes and bands of purple, green and clear. It is sometimes called the student's stone.

It is used for focus, learning, organizing thoughts and making decisions. It is linked with Mercury and with air.

It is fairly soft and can chip, so store it apart from harder stones.
